Multi-Center Observational Study

Authors
A. Researcher, B. Investigator, C. Scientist

Affiliations
Department of Medicine, Alpha University, City A
Department of Clinical Research, Gamma University, City C

Abstract

This multicenter observational study evaluated clinical outcomes in patients recruited from multiple study sites.

Methods

A total of 300 patients were included across multiple centers.

Ethical approval was obtained from the Institutional Review Boards of Alpha University, Beta University, and Gamma University.

Written informed consent was obtained from all participants.

All procedures were performed in accordance with the Declaration of Helsinki and relevant institutional guidelines.

Results

A total of 300 patients were included in the final analysis.

Data Availability

The data generated during this study are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.
